query: 南信牛奶甜品专家 第十甫路 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Xiguan's best-known milk-dessert shop, on Dishifu Road.
summary.zh: 西关最有名的牛奶甜品店，就在第十甫路。

why.en: Double-skin milk custard is made fresh here from buffalo milk and served warm or chilled. The texture is silkier and the milk flavour stronger than chain versions. It is a 2-minute walk from the Shangxiajiu arcades, so it is easily fitted in.
why.zh: 双皮奶用水牛奶现做，冷热都有，口感比连锁店更滑、奶味更浓。离上下九骑楼只要步行两分钟，顺路就能吃。

en: Red bean milk custard (红豆双皮奶)

tips.en: Queues form after dinner; turnover is fast.
tips.zh: 晚饭后会排队，但翻台很快。

query: 百花甜品 文明路 越秀区 广州

summary.en: Old-school tong sui (sweet soup) shop on Wenming Road's dessert street.
summary.zh: 文明路甜品街上的老字号糖水铺。

why.en: Wenming Road is Guangzhou's dessert street, and Baihua is its long-standing anchor. Its sesame and almond pastes are stone-ground and served hot, which is right for a December evening after Beijing Road.
why.zh: 文明路是广州的甜品街，百花是街上的老牌店。芝麻糊、杏仁糊用石磨磨制，热腾腾端上来，十二月逛完北京路吃一碗刚好。

en: Wenming Road's classic tong sui shop

summary.en: Foshan's restored old quarter: grey-brick lanes, Republic-era villas and food.
summary.zh: 佛山修复的老城区：青砖巷子、民国洋楼和美食。

why.en: Lingnan Tiandi is Foshan's best-preserved old town block, set right beside the Ancestral Temple. Qing-dynasty houses, the Jian family villas and the Wedding House are all within a few minutes' walk. Lunch, local snacks and Foshan souvenirs are found in the same lanes, so no car is needed until mid-afternoon.
why.zh: 岭南天地是佛山保留最完整的老城街区，紧挨祖庙。清代民居、简氏别墅、嫁娶屋都在步行几分钟内；午餐、小吃和佛山手信也在同一片巷子里，下午之前都不用坐车。

en: Blind-man cakes and other Foshan souvenirs

query: 陈添记 宝华路十五甫三巷 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Alley shop on Baohua Road, famous for crunchy fish skin since the 1940s.
summary.zh: 宝华路巷子里的老店，以爽鱼皮出名。

why.en: Chen Tim Kee is one of Xiguan’s classic old brands. Its fish skin is blanched, chilled and tossed with peanuts, sesame, coriander and ginger, so it is crunchy rather than fishy. A bowl of sampan congee (艇仔粥) is ordered on the side. It is a few minutes’ walk from Shangxiajiu, so it fits the Dec 21 evening walk.
why.zh: 陈添记是西关的经典老字号。鱼皮焯水后过冷，拌花生、芝麻、香菜和姜丝，爽脆不腥；再配一碗艇仔粥。离上下九只要步行几分钟，正好放在21号晚上的路线里。

en: Xiguan old brand, on the Guangzhou old-brand lists
Crunchy fish skin is the signature

tips.en: Small shop; seating is limited at peak times.

query: 广州酒家 文昌南路2号 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Guangzhou’s best-known Cantonese restaurant brand, founded in 1935.
summary.zh: 1935年创立的广州粤菜代表老字号。

why.en: Guangzhou Restaurant is the name most locals give for “classic Cantonese”. The Wenchang South Road flagship is the original site. Wenchang chicken is served with smooth, yellow skin and ginger-scallion dip, and the dim sum and roast meats are reliable all round. It suits a proper sit-down dinner before the night cruise.
why.zh: 广州酒家是很多本地人心里“正宗粤菜”的代名词，文昌南路是总店原址。文昌鸡皮爽肉滑、配姜葱蓉，点心和烧味都很稳，适合夜游前好好坐下来吃一顿。

tips.en: Queues are long even with a booking (reviews mention 20 min to 2 h). A table should be booked ahead, and the queue can be tracked via WeChat.
tips.zh: 即使订位也常要等（评价提到20分钟到2小时）。建议提前订位，可用微信看排队进度。

name.en: Cha Li Yi Shi (Mall of the World)

query: 茶理宜世 花城汇中区负1层 天河区 广州

summary.en: Guangzhou-born Chinese-style milk tea, inside Mall of the World.
summary.zh: 广州本土国风奶茶，在花城汇里面。

why.en: Cha Li Yi Shi is a Guangzhou brand known for tea-forward, Chinese-style milk teas with floral notes. It sits in the same mall as the dessert stop, so a drink is added without any detour.
why.zh: 茶理宜世是广州本土品牌，奶茶茶味重、带花香，国风设计。就在甜品同一个商场，不用绕路。

en: Yu Yu You Lan (郁郁幽兰)

query: LINLEE手打柠檬茶 北京路168号 越秀区 广州

summary.en: Hand-pounded lemon tea on Beijing Road.
summary.zh: 北京路上的手打柠檬茶。

why.en: LINLEE is the brand most associated with Guangzhou’s hand-pounded lemon tea craze. Fresh lemons are pounded by hand into strong black or green tea, so it is sharp, fragrant and not too sweet. Sugar level can be adjusted when ordering.
why.zh: LINLEE 是广州手打柠檬茶热潮里最有代表性的品牌。新鲜柠檬现场手打，配浓茶底，香气足、酸爽不腻；点单时可以选甜度。

tips.en: Map pin is approximate (168 Beijing Road).
tips.zh: 地图位置为估算（北京路168号）。

aliases: 丘大叔柠檬茶（天河南店）

name.zh: 丘大叔柠檬茶（天河南店）

query: 丘大叔柠檬茶 天河南路80号 天河区 广州

summary.en: The shop that made duck-shit oolong lemon tea famous.
summary.zh: 把鸭屎香柠檬茶带火的店。

why.en: Uncle Qiu popularised lemon tea made with duck-shit oolong (鸭屎香), a Phoenix dancong tea named for its soil, not its taste. The tea gives a floral, honeyed aroma under the lemon. It is between K Hotel and Grandview Mall.
why.zh: 丘大叔把鸭屎香柠檬茶带火：鸭屎香是凤凰单丛的一种，名字来自土壤，跟味道无关，茶香带花蜜味。店就在 K Hotel 和正佳之间。

en: Duck-shit oolong lemon tea (鸭屎香柠檬茶)

why.zh: 茶理宜世是天河南一路上的奶茶选择，去正佳的路上经过。茶味重、带花香。

query: Capital Cafe 華星冰室 6 Heard Street Wan Chai Hong Kong

summary.en: Popular Hong Kong ice café known for milk tea and scrambled-egg toast.
summary.zh: 香港人气冰室，奶茶和炒蛋多士出名。

why.en: Capital Café is one of Hong Kong’s best-known cha chaan teng-style ice cafés. Silky milk tea is served with fluffy scrambled-egg toast or a crispy condensed-milk bun, the classic afternoon break. It fits the Wan Chai stop on the way back to West Kowloon.
why.zh: 華星冰室是香港最有名的冰室之一。滑奶茶配嫩滑炒蛋多士或脆皮奶油猪仔包，是经典下午茶。正好在回西九龙前的湾仔站。

en: Crispy condensed-milk bun (脆皮奶油猪仔包)

tips.en: Queues are moderate to long; shared tables are normal. Hours are roughly 07:00–21:00/22:00.
tips.zh: 排队中到长，拼桌很正常。营业时间约07:00–21:00/22:00。
